title: A Scholarship for the Group Chat
author: Gideon Amberdale
blurb: Oscar Okafor, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
